name: Business Partnerships
overview: Scripture teaches that business partnerships require agreement and mutual support, as Amos 3:3 asks if two can walk together unless they agree. Proverbs warns of the dangers in becoming surety for others, highlighting the risks involved in binding agreements with strangers (Proverbs 6:1; 11:15). True partnership involves sharpening and strengthening one another, much like iron sharpens iron (Proverbs 27:17). Additionally, faithfulness to God's commandments is essential in all relationships, including business, as Jesus emphasizes the importance of obedience and teaching in Matthew 5:19. Jesus' instruction to 'launch out into the deep' (Luke 5:4) encourages stepping out in faith with wise counsel and trust in God's guidance.
